title: Past Tense & Near Future
description: Practice common preterite forms and the near future with 'ir + infinitive'.

questions.prompt: Complete: Ontem eu ___ arroz com feijão. (comer)
Complete: Nós ___ ao cinema no sábado passado. (ir)
Which sentence uses the near future correctly?
questions.explanation: Near future is 'ir' in the present plus infinitive: 'vou estudar'.

questions.prompt: Complete: Ela ___ português quando era criança. (falar)
questions.explanation: 'Quando era criança' describes a habitual past action, so the imperfect 'falava' fits.

options: Eles vão comprar um carro ontem.
questions.explanation: A completed action yesterday uses the preterite 'compraram'.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct translation of 'I am going to call you later.'
options: Eu vou te ligar mais tarde.
Eu vou te liguei mais tarde.
questions.answer: Eu vou te ligar mais tarde.
questions.explanation: 'Vou te ligar' is natural Brazilian Portuguese for 'I am going to call you'.
